name: awfixer-nixos
description: Grok plugins shipped by this NixOS config. Home Manager installs each one under ~/.grok/plugins/<name>.

plugins.name: helium-devtools
plugins.description: Connect Grok to the already-open daily Helium via the local helium-devtools MCP (DevTools, extensions, cookies, page automation).

plugins.name: bun
plugins.description: Force Bun for JavaScript/TypeScript: official docs MCP, reject node/npm/pnpm/yarn, and prefer Bun builtins over packages like ws and sharp.
